prompt: When are Sieve filters usually applied to an email?
choices: When the email is delivered to a mailbox
When the email is relayed by an SMTP server
When the email is sent to the first server by an MUA
When the email is received by an SMTP smarthost
When the email is retrieved by an MUA
explanation: Sieve runs at final delivery (by the MDA/LDA), as the message is filed into a mailbox.
